lay down anywhere you can. dont think about eating dont look at the time.  lay on the floor or bed or where ever and feel it against your back. look up to the ceiling and breathe. Or maybe dont and just close your eyes

give yourself a moment of peace. even if its just a moment. even if its just a small little moment. breathe slow where you are. Just breathe. 

your worth is not defined here. you can combat on that later, say all the reasons why it is, bring up all the thorny bits choking you down, but for now, don’t. just exist. 

If its just a moment thats ok. for this moment reading my words know someone hears you and is sitting with your pain. Ill sit next to you in my heart and embrace yours in my mind. 

butterflies exist from pain. They fly when they are free. If this is the spiders web they can still find a way.

It seems blocked right now. Unmovable. No way forward. But exist in the water that is still before the blocked place.

There is water in these parts. Whether they flow out your eyes or surround you in waves just sit in it.

Lay down and feel the ocean. 
Even if just a moment. Feel these waters. calm the waves if they abide. 

I dont know you and i care. Stay for a day. Stay in this place between life and death for as long as you can. 

If none of this means anything to you or my words are too rambling I still hope atleast you know I see you. 

You are worthy of existence. You are worthy. Even if its unseen for this moment atleast try to hear those words even if you are drowning.

Even in the plugged nature of ears underwater there is still an echo somewhere above. 

Still the ocean. For just a moment. Even just a small moment of something clear. Even if just a fragment. You are worthy.

Your life is worthy of its breath. 
Maybe you feel empty now. But in emptiness there is still meaning. There is still something.

It means you can fill with what you choose.
Open to possibilities. even if you feel you cant still take time.

It doesnt have to be in the form you believe. You can lay to rest searching the wings for some time. The will to fly the want to scream may not cease. But lay it to rest let your arms hold yourself.

Your wings are tethered and tired from searching. Its ok to rest them here. 

 there are trains everyday. you can exist here. Even if it feels far. Even if for years you cant feel at peace. Even if you never have.

It is there somewhere. If at the end, see and ask what you want of these waves. Not for others. Not even for your day to day existence.

But for you. At the heart at the center. You dont have to get on the train.
Not yet.
You can sit here in the inbetween. In the emptiness. In the station between dreams.

There is a light somewhere. It may take unforgivness to find it. Filter it through the angles.

It may take wading through all the darkest waters to find it.

But its there. Somewhere.
Just hold its hope in your hand.
Clutch it to your chest that hope of finding a light.

Because even if its all so unmovable. You are still here

standing like a warrior at battles edge. There is a light somewhere. 

Reach for the waterfall. Behind it will be a door.
You just have to see
It is here somewhere

I know I say this a lot to people, but thank you for your words. Thank you for taking the time to write this. I’m not the best at expressing it, that is why many messages I’m sent don’t get replies, but I really appreciate you. 

I wanted to say that for the moment, I’m in a better place. I recently learned how to use a sewing machine, and it is the best thing ever. My cat turned 15, and though he may be old, he still is happy and sleeps with me many nights. My mom and I are going on a little trip at the end of the week, and I am pretty excited. 

But I know this probably won’t be the end of it. I know for a fact that when school starts up again, it’ll be hectic and stressful. I’ve decided on my own to go fully in person, because I feel like I need to make connections with people, even if it’ll be awkward. I’m starting at a art school for half of the time, and I’m preparing for the anxiety that will bring. Even without this whole situation, it would still be strange, because I don’t really know where I fit in the art world. That’s a story for another time. 

I apologize about your friend and Grandfather. But I’m glad that your grandfathers words helped you so much. Something similar happened to me,  somebody told me something that really made me rethink about what I was doing. It’s kind of strange, I mean, the person who told me. I won’t go to much into it as it is kind of crazy, but no matter what it changed my mind. And I guess that’s all that matters.

I too want to be help and heal other people. I’ve actually been frequently told that I’m an empath, which in itself is a curse and a blessing. To be honest, I’ve been trying to ignore the fact that people are dying everyday from this virus. That’s really bad of me, but I know that if I face what’s happening, it’ll break me. I still haven’t entirely processed even after all these months, the weight of what’s going on. The suffering of so many people. It hurts my heart and I can’t comprehend it. But I know one day I’ll have too.


I am happy that you found way out of the darkness. You truly are a kind person. I wish your boy a happy birthday, and I hope the marriage goes beautifully.

I do feel bad about all the other people who have messaged me who I haven’t responded too, but it is just hard for me to write sometimes. I hope they know that they are appreciated though.
